opportunities.name: Time zone comparison and holiday check, then sync email draft
opportunities.description: Compare two cities in the timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up the holidays of one country, then compose a 'Sync' email with the hour offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Select the country of city B
Enter recipient, subject 'Sync: A / B, Month', and body with offset and dates to avoid

instances.values: New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, ops@example.com, December, 6 hours, avoid Dec 25 and 26
London / Sydney, Australia holidays, ops@example.com, January, 10 hours, avoid Jan 1 and 26

opportunities.name: Company research brief: EDGAR 10-K lookup, Wikipedia, email
opportunities.description: Look up a company by ticker on SEC EDGAR full-text search, filter to 10-K annual reports, check the company on Wikipedia, then email an account brief.
steps: Open EDGAR search, enter ticker in company field and pick the suggestion
Run the search and filter Form to 10-K annual reports
Search the company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Enter recipient, subject 'Account brief: Company (TICKER)', and body with HQ, employees, CEO and latest 10-K date

instances.values: SNOW, Snowflake, 10-K filter (no Wikipedia or email step seen)
HUBS, HubSpot, marc@example.com, brief with HQ Cambridge, 8,246 employees, CEO Yamini Rangan, 10-K 2026-02-11

opportunities.name: EDGAR company filings search by ticker
opportunities.description: Search SEC EDGAR for a company's filings by ticker, select the autocomplete suggestion, and run the search to list its filings.
steps: Click the company/ticker field and clear it
Open the Form filter to narrow by filing type
